assumptions.description: External rural Malawi/Ghana evidence informs an adult scenario; unknown target age/sex/BMI/site/lifestyle composition is not identified. External strata are not target lifestyle classes or known mixture fractions.

BMI constructs and numerical lipid units are transported despite different fasting, specimen and laboratory protocols versus target venous EDTA immediate CardioChek Plus; no calibrated assay bridge is available. A38.67 unit conversion is not assay equivalence.

Source age and health/complete-case restrictions differ; target excludes none of pregnancy, HIV, diabetes or fasting status by inference. Effects of this selection difference are absorbed into an unverified transport assumption.

Pooled source rural Spearman dependence is applied within each sex; pooled Agongo lipid CVs are applied within each sex. Source conditioning does not identify the requested age/sex/BMI-conditioned law.

Unadjusted rank/marginal evidence is only a component of adjusted raw-scale analyses. The full model supplies the adjustment relationships; no unadjusted statistic is relabelled as an adjusted slope or residual correlation.

Geometric scales, arithmetic mean/SD ratios and Spearman ranks play distinct roles. Gaussian-copula and lognormal identities are model-based derivations, not changes to source definitions. Target OLS uses raw lipids and BMI, conversion38.67 and per5 BMI reporting.

All source weighting remains not_reported. Unknown quantile, tie, missing-pair and SD-denominator details stay unresolved. Modeling assumptions never authorize a substitute source operator; unsupported geometric/log operators remain unavailable.

Within each sex the latent age/BMI/TC/HDL vector is multivariate Gaussian with the declared unit variances and matrix. Rural Spearman entries map by2*sin(pi*r_s/6) under a continuous Gaussian copula. Homogeneous sex dependence and pooled-to-within-sex transfer are assumptions, not reported source facts.

Lognormal marginal log SD=sqrt(log(1+(SD/mean)^2)); transfer Agongo sex-specific BMI CVs and pooled lipid CVs from ages40-60 to each adult stratum. No source arithmetic mean is imposed and no marginal SD becomes a conditional residual SD.

Use Greiner Malawi rural sex-specific BMI/TC/HDL geometric means as the scenario geometric scales, with no precision weights or target matching. These values combined with separately transferred CVs do not reconstruct any source cohort.

Use sex-specific source age quartile locations as knots of a continuous piecewise-linear inverse CDF at0,.25,.5,.75,1, with endpoints18 and85. The85 boundary is a modeled tail, not target eligibility; interpolation and tail shape are unreported assumptions.
Latent age correlations with BMI/TC/HDL are respectively.12/.25/.05. They are constructor-selected modest dependencies, not estimated source slopes or source correlations.
Source women/men summaries are assigned to target literal F/M respectively although that biological legend is not independently verified in admitted target metadata.
P(F)=.50 independently of the latent vector is a balanced synthetic composition, not a reported source or target fraction.

Bounded age/sex and a finite mixture of exponentials of Gaussian vectors give finite joint positive polynomial moments. Positive-definite latent covariance supplies nondegenerate predictors and lipid residual variation; no exponential of lognormal BMI is used.

All rows are generated directly without clipping/rejection. Positive lognormal margins permit rare TC<HDL; this disclosed separate-assay model limitation is not silently repaired and does not introduce a target exclusion.

Within-study summaries are dependent; no participant-level overlap audit is asserted. Seeds vary individuals only; structure, selection, transport and parameter uncertainty are uncalibrated and fixed.

Produce the task-requested3000 independent rows with unique deterministic string IDs and required column order. No observed individual inputs exist. Row count is a prospective design quantity, not target n.

margins.derivation: Geometric means taken as scenario scales. Four log SDs computed as sqrt(log(1+(SD/mean)^2)) from arithmetic Agongo summary pairs; see approved aggregate recheck. No uncertainty or residual-SD conversion.

latent_correlation.derivation: Rural rank entries transformed by2*sin(pi*r_s/6); age row.12/.25/.05 assumed; unit diagonal by latent standardization. Values preserve approved proposal.
